attributes.name: Vicious Double Axe +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d10+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d8+3. If you aren't proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

When you play this weapon, you are dealt 1 Force damage that cannot be reduced.
